The tablist accessibilityLabel reuses the source's exact shortcuts.filter.all key.

Rule 7 native-safe adaptations, all DOM-free: (1) @/hooks/useShortcutRegistry wires a delegated document 'keydown' listener and stores match/handler typed against the DOM KeyboardEvent (no global document/KeyboardEvent in RN) -> inlined a native-safe registry preserving the read contract (useAllShortcuts via useSyncExternalStore with a cached stable snapshot) and the write contract (registerShortcut/unregisterShortcut, deduped by id), with the browser-only match/handler fields omitted from ShortcutDefinition; the registry is empty by default so the modal renders its explicit empty state (shortcuts.empty) — the honest 'unavailable on native' surface, with future hardware-keyboard population possible via the same API. (2) react-router-dom useLocation().pathname -> optional pageRoute prop (default '') feeding the 'This page' scope filter. (3) window.sessionStorage filter persistence -> in-memory session-scoped storedFilter (no cross-launch persistence; 'all' is the intended default, mirroring the web 'all' fallback and validation of the three legal values).

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported. Shared web Modal/SearchInput and DOM div/button/section/h3/span/kbd/p replaced with React Native Modal/ScrollView/View/Pressable/TextInput + AppText, styled via StyleSheet against theme tokens (colors/spacing/typography): the web Modal -> RN transparent fade Modal with overlay+backdrop Pressable+dialog (mirrors the FeedbackModal native port); SearchInput -> inline ShortcutSearchInput that faithfully reproduces the controlled value re-sync + setTimeout debounce (debounceMs=120 preserved) with a clear (✕) Pressable; the role='tablist'/role='tab' filter chips -> accessibilityRole tablist/tab Pressables with accessibilityState selected; the scrollable groups list (max-h-[60vh]) -> ScrollView with maxHeight = useWindowDimensions().height*0.6; each <kbd> chip -> a bordered View + monospace AppText; the '+' separator and min-w-[24px] center alignment preserved. CSS var colors mapped to tokens (--text-primary/secondary/muted, --glass-border->border, --surface-2->surfaceRaised, --accent-blue/20->accentSoft). aria-* -> accessibility* props.
Verified via the required gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet, and npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
